name: 金数据
examples_zh: 帮我建一个「春季发布会报名表」，字段：姓名、手机号、公司、参会城市（北京/上海/深圳/线上）
查「客户登记表」里本周新增且来自上海的记录，按时间倒序给我前 20 条
把「报名表」里手机号以 138 开头的记录，跟进状态都改成「已联系」
examples_en: Create a 'Spring Launch Sign-up' form with fields: name, phone, company, city (Beijing/Shanghai/Shenzhen/Online)
Query this week's new entries from Shanghai in 'Customer Registration', top 20 by time desc
Bulk-update follow-up status to 'Contacted' for entries whose phone starts with 138 in 'Sign-up Form'
